steps.reason: You already have basic HTML/CSS knowledge. JavaScript is the critical prerequisite needed to make interfaces interactive before starting React.
acceptanceCriteria: Create variables, loops, arrays, and functions to calculate totals
Manipulate the DOM to dynamically display expense items
Handle user form events and validate numerical input
Store and retrieve data from browser localStorage
steps.beginnerTip: Practice writing small 10-line scripts in the browser console before building the project.

steps.reason: Required to track your code versions, publish projects on GitHub Pages, and share work with local Bhopal/Indore dev communities.
acceptanceCriteria: Initialize a Git repository and make meaningful commit messages
Push your project code to a public GitHub repository
Enable GitHub Pages to generate a live, shareable URL
steps.beginnerTip: Treat each git commit like a safe checkpoint in a video game.

steps.reason: The most widely used UI library for web development in regional tech hubs and remote roles.
acceptanceCriteria: Deconstruct a page into reusable JSX components
Manage interactive state with useState hook
Handle side-effects and localStorage syncing with useEffect
Pass props and event callback handlers cleanly
steps.beginnerTip: Keep components small. One component should do one clear job.

steps.reason: Speeds up UI construction and ensures responsive styling on mobile screens used by learners in Tier-2 regions.
acceptanceCriteria: Style responsive layouts using utility classes
Implement dark mode and mobile navigation drawer
Ensure WCAG AA contrast standards for accessibility
steps.beginnerTip: Design mobile layout first, then expand with md: and lg: breakpoints.

steps.reason: Allows mentors and potential collaborators to test your live working application on any device.
acceptanceCriteria: Deploy application to Vercel or Netlify with continuous deployment
Write a descriptive README with project walkthrough GIF and live link
Ensure page loads in under 2 seconds on mobile data
steps.beginnerTip: Ask a friend with an Android phone on 4G to test your live link.
